description: This file defines the Web Application Initializer for a Spring MVC project, configuring root and servlet-specific application contexts, and servlet mappings.

classes.name: MvcWebApplicationInitializer
classes.description: Subclass of AbstractAnnotationConfigDispatcherServletInitializer that sets up the root and web application contexts and servlet mappings for the Spring MVC application.

methods.name: getRootConfigClasses
methods.description: Returns the configuration classes for the root application context, including Hibernate and Security configurations.

methods.name: getServletConfigClasses
methods.description: Returns the configuration class for the DispatcherServlet application context.

methods.name: getServletMappings
methods.description: Defines the URL pattern this DispatcherServlet will handle, mapping it to '/'.
